about: Update-ChatqClaudeState / Update-ChatqCodexState (src/queue.ps1, by input.provider) from New-ChatqRunState, fed input.lines in order. A line is a string, or a recipe {parts: [[text, count], ...], length}: each text count times, length UTF-16 units in all. The answer is St after the last line; with input.each, the list of St after each line; with input.fresh, each item of input.lines (a line, or a list of lines) runs from its own New-ChatqRunState and the answer is the list of St after each item. input.fields keeps only those fields, in that order. St is SPEC 3.8's transport: each New-ChatqRunState field by its own name, in its order; scalars and lists as JSON values; ToolIds an object; Result, Rate and Limit the raw line each was set from, or null. Each answer was rebuilt from that JSON in PowerShell (the raw lines through ConvertFrom-Json, .rate_limit_info for Rate and Limit) and compared with the real St. Started stays false: the run's OnLine sets it, not these functions. Made under en-US.
